items.title: Americans are on a 'treadmill of high inflation' and more rate hikes are likely, San Francisco Fed's Daly says
items.summary: San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly called Friday's jobs report "good news for American workers," but noted the pressure inflation is exerting on household finances

items.title: Trump promotes Stephen Miller to become new White House chief of staff
items.summary: Trump said Miller, currently a deputy to Susie Wiles and “one of my most trusted advisers”, would start in the top job on Monday.

items.title: In French City Hit by Terrorist Attack, Residents Blame Far-Right Rhetoric
items.summary: In Trappes, a suburb of Paris with a large immigrant population, residents believe that a shooting was fueled by years of anti-immigrant sentiment.

items.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
items.summary: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

items.title: Tallow could help solve Australia's fuel shortages
items.summary: Australia's booming tallow industry could help reduce the nation's reliance on imported fuel, with plans to turn animal by-products into renewable fuels on home soil.

items.title: Meghan Markle's father arrested in US over child sex abuse images
